title: 9/14 private mode: pick_delivery = private alone would not have silenced the entry-check nags; the operator also disabled the cron
tier_reason: unwanted entry nags after the owner stopped entering (DM noise); the operator's crontab edit held; next season's cron install re-enables the nag as intended

contract.text: When the owner stops entering picks (season over; 'silence' = keep collecting, stop DMs), the service stops entry-check nags while still computing and grading picks.
contract.source: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-14-season-wrap-plan.md (box state row); operator instruction recorded in the 9/14 memory note

mechanism.text: check-pick-entered gates on daily_decision.is_scoreable_commit, which is true for private_locked commits (by design: in manual-entry private mode silence is the incident class), so private mode alone keeps the */15 nag and the EOD pick_entry WARN

mitigated.action: set pick_delivery = private and commented the */15 check-pick-entered crontab line (snapshots *.bak-20260914-season-over)

config.pins: a private_locked scoreable commit with no contest entry makes check-pick-entered DM 'NOT entered' — private mode alone does not silence the entry check

residual.text: There is no single 'season over / research-only' operating mode: silencing needs both the TOML and a crontab edit, and cron-setup-hetzner.sh install re-enables the nag (intended for next season; a 2027 checklist item). Nagging in private mode is the designed behaviour for manual entry; what remains is procedural (the checklist), not a code path that misbehaves.

watchdog.trigger: the configured delivery mode, the entry-check cron and the operator's declared entry intent disagree (e.g. private mode + no entries + nag cron enabled, or dm mode + nag cron disabled)
watchdog.recovery_assertion: config matches the declared operating mode per the season-start checklist

evidence.what: box state: private mode, DMs off, nag cron disabled; picks still computed and graded

evidence.locator: operator memory note (claude-shared bts_index 'Season 2026 final'; not in the repo)
evidence.what: left as-is the box would DM ~3 check-pick-entered nags a day because is_scoreable_commit covers private_locked; silence applied ~15:45 ET: TOML pick_delivery = private + the cron line commented
a private_locked scoreable commit with no entry alerts

notes: the control that held is the operator's two-part config change, applied before any nag; Route R (cron.log, crontab snapshots in B1) can verify no nag DM followed
policy_objective emax_season_best: the tail regime was active from 9/03
